title: Nondistinguished faces decrease the fillable squiggle rank
statement:
Let $\mathsf{Adj}$ be the nerve-enriched free strict adjunction, using the atomic string normal form of [lem-coef-adjunction-squiggle-normal-form] and the fillable arrows, depth $k$, child $a^-$ and parent $b^\dagger$ of [lem-coef-adjunction-fillable-parent-bijection]. For a fillable arrow $c$ define $\rho(c)=(w(c),k(c),\dim c)$, putting $k(\ell)=0$ for the unique fillable $0$-arrow. Order triples lexicographically, first by width, then depth, then dimension.

For every fillable $n$-arrow $a$ with $n\geq1$ and every $0\leq i\leq n$ other than its depth $k(a)$, decompose $d_i a$ into its unique word of degeneracies of nondegenerate atomic arrows. For each nondegenerate atomic factor $b$ in that word, put $g(b)=b$ if $b$ is fillable, and $g(b)=b^\dagger$ otherwise. Then $\rho(g(b))<\rho(a)$. An identity face has an empty word, so the assertion includes that case.
